verdict.rationale: TruffleHog ships as an official first-party CLI. It installs via Homebrew or Docker and has documented subcommands (github, git, scan, analyze) and flags (--only-verified, --include-detectors, --verify-detectors, --results, --fail), with a probe confirming the official CLI is documented in the GitHub repo. missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of CLI usage, explicit documentation of agent-oriented or machine-readable output modes.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: the `--verify-detectors` and `--no-verify-detectors` CLI flags can be used to configure detector-specific verification override settings
